data.title: 欧根亲王 · 假日晨曦的丝被独憩
data.description: 晨光穿透白纱轻洒在宽大柔软的双人床上。欧根亲王侧卧在凌乱的真丝床单间，宽松温暖的针织毛衣半褪至臂弯，露出细腻光洁的香肩与纤细锁骨。她半眯着双眼，纤长玉指卷起一缕散落的银发，嘴角挂着满足而微慵的甜笑，尽显无防备的女友感。
data.location: sun-drenched morning bedroom with soft white linen
data.action: lying on side amidst rumpled white bed sheets, oversized knit sweater slipping off shoulder, twirling silver hair strand with finger, golden morning light, playful relaxed gaze
data.lighting: bright warm morning sunbeams diffusing through white sheer curtains
data.mood: indulgent weekend warmth, tender seductive domesticity
data.promptProse: Lying leisurely amidst rumpled white bedding in the golden morning light, Prinz Eugen wears a soft off-shoulder sweater slipping over bare skin. She twirls a strand of silver hair with an affectionate, playful smile.
data.animaCaption: Prinz Eugen waking up on rumpled bedsheets in an off-shoulder knit sweater, smiling softly.
